_note: Publisher settings (publish/run.mjs). Tier A = official facts written by code (events, status, dates). A run that would change more tracked entries than max_entries_changed_per_run is treated as an anomaly: nothing is written. auto_publish switches stay off until the field scores at the bar on the accuracy test set (phase 4).

gate_override._note: eval/gate.mjs: an owner's explicit decision to let a switch publish without a passing test report. Every run report says so (update.mjs). The entries themselves still go through every check (scope check, reviewer, code checks, guards, the per-run cap). Delete a switch's entry to restore the gate.

new_entries.reason: accepted the live test of 31 Oct 2026 (test set 0 wrong; unseen set not rerun after the timeout fix) instead of a further paid run

new_bills_gate._note: eval/gate.mjs (owner, 31 Oct 2026): the new-bills measure (eval/newbill-eval.mjs) may cover at least this many bills of each set instead of the whole set, to keep the paid test small. Still at zero wrong, every scope call right, no error, at least one bill published, by the current code and the production models, and over the right set (the unseen set by its pinned fingerprints). Remove a set's number to require the whole set again.

links._note: The links step of update.mjs (links/run.mjs). For every entry added or changed in a run, code proposes links (a lead sponsor already in the network, a bill amending a tracked law). AI links need a quote from both bills found by code and the validator's agreement. While auto_publish.relationships is off, proposals are only listed in the run report under Links proposed; when on, links/apply.mjs adds them (additions only, checked by publish/guards.mjs). Code-only backtest: node links/backtest.mjs.

news._note: News card wording (news/writer.mjs). ai_writer false (default, decided 29 Oct 2026 after review round 3): every card is written by the phrase bank (news/phrasebank.mjs: fixed hand-reviewed variants filled from the fact sheet, no AI). true: the free AI writer checked by code and a second reader; the gate then also needs an AI-written card in the news_writer report, recorded with the production generator and validator models.

eval_bar._note: Set by the owner. A field may auto-publish only when the latest test-set report (eval/run.mjs) for the production model meets all three: share of in-scope test items whose field passes, published fields with an unsupported quote or number, and scope agreement.

ai_step._note: The AI step of update.mjs (agents on material changes and new-bill candidates). max_items_per_run bounds one run; the monthly cap in config/models.json bounds the month. New-bill drafts are published by Tier B (publish/tier-b.mjs) only when auto_publish.new_entries is on, at most max_new_entries_per_run per run; while it is off they are reported as ready.

self_correction._note: The self-correction step of update.mjs (correct/run.mjs). Once a day it reads every tracked bill's official text (free APIs), and re-checks up to max_entries_per_run entries against it: text changed first, then failed checks (up to max_retries), then entries never checked, then the one checked longest ago (after recheck_after_days). The reader (role reviewer) proposes; the confirmer (role confirmer) must agree; code checks quotes and numbers. Only mechanism, thresholds and penalties change. Every entry may be corrected, hand-written ones included (owner, 27 Oct 2026).

courts._note: The court-docket step of update.mjs (publish/courts.mjs): reads the docket entries of the cases in config/courts.json filed since the last run (state in state/courts-state.json) from CourtListener (COURTLISTENER_API_TOKEN; at most 5 requests a minute, max_requests_per_run per run) and writes the material ones as Tier A facts: events, and for orders, judgments and appeals a status-text line and a fixed-wording news item.

news_leads._note: The leads half of the news step (news/run.mjs). Reads the feeds in config/news-sources.json (items from the last max_age_days days) and screens headlines (code words, then the AI role screener). Leads are only reported; a primary lead may attach to an existing official event as a statement (headline + link). News items come only from official records (news/events.mjs), written to news.json only when auto_publish.news is on. max_drafts_per_run and max_rounds are no longer used.

notify._note: Telegram run report after every run (needs TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN or TELEGRAM_ACCESS_TOKEN and TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID). A dry run sends one only with --notify.
